title: 第10章  吉时已到，出发接亲！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
夜色如墨，御书房内灯火通明。
李擎苍一身戎装，快步踏入殿内，冰冷的甲胄在寂静的宫殿中发出轻微的碰撞声。
他单膝跪地，头颅低垂。
“臣，李擎苍，参见陛下！”
龙椅之上，赵道霆的身影笼罩在阴影中，看不真切。
却有一股渊渟岳峙的气息，压得李擎苍几乎喘不过气来。
这股气息……比陛下闭关前，更加恐怖了！
“平身吧。”
平淡的两个字响起，那股山岳般的压力却瞬间消失得无影无踪，仿佛从未出现过。
“谢陛下！”
李擎苍站起身，依旧低着头，不敢直视天颜。
赵道霆并未说话，御书房内陷入了死一般的沉寂。
每一息，对李擎苍而言都如同一个世纪般漫长。
他心中忐忑，完全猜不透陛下深夜召见，所为何事。
是为了青鸾的婚事？
是敲打，还是安抚？
就在他胡思乱想之际，赵道霆终于开口了。
“擎苍，你随朕征战多少年了？”
李擎苍心中一凛，连忙躬身回答：
“回陛下，自陛下登基之日起，臣便追随陛下，至今已二十有六年。”

“二十六年……”
赵道霆的声音里带着一丝莫名的感慨：
“你李家，世代忠良。”
“为陛下尽忠，为大周赴死，乃臣之本分！”
李擎苍斩钉截铁地说道。
赵道霆从龙椅上缓缓站起，一步步走下台阶，来到李擎苍面前。
他并未再说话，只是伸出一根手指，对着身旁一张由千年寒铁打造的桌案，轻轻一点。
没有真元波动，没有灵力外泄。
就那么轻描淡写的一点。
一声轻响。
那张坚不可摧，足以抵挡道宫境强者全力一击的寒铁桌案，竟以他手指点中的位置为中心。
无声无息地化作了一捧比尘埃还要细腻的黑色粉末，簌簌地洒落在地。
李擎苍的身体猛地一僵。
他死死地盯着地上那捧粉末，整个人如遭雷击，脑海中掀起了滔天巨浪！
这不是力量的碾压！
这是……道的湮灭！
是更高层次的法则之力，将寒铁的本质彻底抹除！
这种手段，别说四极境，就算是传说中的化龙境大能，也绝无可能做到！
这……这是……
“天品功法！”

四个字，几乎是从李擎苍的牙缝里挤出来的。他的身体因为极度的震惊而微微颤抖。
唯有传说中直指仙台大道的天品功法，才拥有如此匪夷所思的威能！
陛下……陛下竟然修成了天品功法？！
难怪闭关六日，气息便有了天翻地覆的变化！
可陛下为何要让自己看这个？
一个恐怖而又荒谬的念头，不受控制地从李擎苍心底冒了出来。
难不成……
赵道霆看着他惊骇欲绝的模样，嘴角逸出一丝难言的笑意。
“你心中所想，便是朕的答案。”
李擎苍的脑子彻底炸开了。
他双腿一软。
“噗通”一声，重重地跪在了地上，整个人都懵了。
“陛……陛下！万万不可！”
他的声音都在发颤，这已经不是赏赐，这是催命符！
“天品功法，乃皇室立身之根本，是绝对的不传之秘！”
“传于外臣，此乃动摇国本的大罪！臣……臣万死不敢接受！”
赵道霆却只是静静地看着他，那种深邃的目光，仿佛早已洞穿了他所有的想法。
“朕知道你在担心什么。”
“但从青鸾那孩子嫁给安儿的那一刻起，你李家，便不再是纯粹的外臣。”
“朕与你，是君臣，亦是……亲家。”

这两个字如同一道九天惊雷，在李擎苍的脑海中轰然炸响！
他猛地抬起头，呆呆地看着眼前的帝王。
瞬间，所有的一切都串联起来了！
女儿那句“无比丰厚，也无比安稳的——未来”，言犹在耳！
原来如此！
原来这才是陛下的真正目的！
赐婚，不是为了羞辱，更不是为了敲打！
而是为了打破君臣之间的那层隔阂，是为了让赏赐这天品功法变得名正言顺！
是为了将他李家，彻底地、牢不可破地绑上皇室的战车！
女儿……我的女儿啊！
她竟然在圣旨下达的那一刻，就洞悉了这深埋在九重宫阙之下的帝王心术！
李擎苍心中又是震撼，又是狂喜，又是惭愧。
他自诩沙场宿将，却在格局和眼光上，被自己那个足不出户的女儿，甩开了十万八千里！
“臣……谢陛下天恩！”
李擎苍重重地一个响头磕在地上，再无半分犹豫。
君以国士待我，我必国士报之！
赵道霆满意地点了点头，他要的，就是李擎苍这份绝对的忠诚。
他伸出一指，点在李擎苍的眉心。
“凝神，静气。”
一股浩瀚无垠，玄奥至极的信息洪流，瞬间涌入了李擎苍的脑海。

《大道天衍经》！
霸道！玄妙！神异！
无数他从未想象过的修行理念，一个个神妙的法门，在他识海中炸开。
彻底颠覆了他过去上百年的修行认知。
原来，轮海可以这样开辟！
原来，道宫可以如此演化！
他沉浸在这天品功法的玄奥之中，无法自拔，整个人都陷入了一种奇妙的顿悟状态。
许久，当他从那种状态中挣脱出来时，赵道霆已经重新坐回了龙椅之上。
李擎苍再度叩首，这一次，是发自内心的敬畏与臣服。
“臣李擎苍，愿为陛下，肝脑涂地，万死不辞！”
赵道霆端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口，仿佛做了一件微不足道的小事。
他放下茶杯，状似随意地开口。
“这份功法，朕是为了安儿传给你的。”
“咔！”
李擎苍刚刚抬起的头，瞬间僵住。
他整个人仿佛被施了定身术，跪在那里的姿态，瞬间凝固成了一座雕塑。
什……什么？
是……谁给的？
十六皇子？
那个无法开辟苦海，被全皇城视为废物的……赵辰安？！

李擎苍虽然憨，但不傻。
听到这话，他已然知晓，自己和李家，今后将要彻底绑在十六皇子的身上了！
次日，清晨。
天光乍亮，整座皇城还笼罩在一片朦胧的晨曦之中。
十六皇子府邸门前，却已是人声鼎沸，一片喧腾的火红。
数百名禁军甲胄鲜明，手持长戟，肃立两侧。
组成两条威武雄壮的长龙，从府门口一直延伸到长街尽头。
禁军之后，是上百名身着喜庆红衣的乐师，抱着各式乐器，整装待发。
长长的接亲队伍，一眼望不到头。
八抬大轿，金顶红幔，上面绣着龙凤呈祥的图案，华贵无比。
这阵仗，这规模，哪里是娶一个侧妃？
便是当年皇后入宫，也不过如此！
整个皇城都被惊动了！
无数百姓和修士从家中涌出，站在街道两侧。
对着这支豪华到极致的队伍，指指点点，满脸的不可思议。
一名穿着大红喜袍，身姿挺拔的青年，正跨坐在一匹神骏非凡的白色龙马之上。
正是这场盛大婚礼的主角，赵辰安。
他脸上挂着爽朗的笑容，目光越过人群，望向车骑将军府的方向。
司仪官高高举起手中的令旗，深吸一口气，用尽全身力气，发出一声嘹亮的呐喊。
“吉时已到！”

“起乐！出发！”
content_en:
The night is as dark as ink, and the lights in the imperial study are brightly lit.
Li Qingcang was dressed in military uniform and quickly stepped into the palace. His cold armor made a slight collision sound in the silent palace.
He knelt on one knee, head bowed.
"My lord, Li Qingcang, see your Majesty!"
On the dragon chair, Zhao Daoting's figure was shrouded in shadow, making it difficult to see clearly.
But there was an aura of Yuan Ting and Yue Zhi that made Li Qingcang almost breathless.
This aura... is even more terrifying than before Your Majesty went into seclusion!
"Get flat."
As soon as the two plain words rang out, the mountain-like pressure disappeared without a trace in an instant, as if it had never appeared.
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
Li Qingcang stood up, still lowering his head, not daring to look directly at Tianyan.
Zhao Daoting did not speak, and the imperial study fell into a deathly silence.
Every breath is as long as a century to Li Qingcang.
He felt uneasy and couldn't figure out why His Majesty summoned him late at night.
Is it for Qingluan’s marriage?
Is it beating or comforting?
Just as he was thinking wildly, Zhao Daoting finally spoke.
"Qingcang, how many years have you been fighting with me?"
Li Qingcang's heart trembled, and he quickly bowed and answered:
"Returning to Your Majesty, I have been following Your Majesty since the day Your Majesty ascended the throne. It has been twenty-six years now."
"Twenty-six years..."
There was a hint of inexplicable emotion in Zhao Daoting's voice:
"Your Li family has been loyal for generations."
"It is my duty to be loyal to His Majesty and to die for the Great Zhou Dynasty!"
Li Qingcang said decisively.
Zhao Daoting slowly stood up from the dragon chair, walked down the steps step by step, and came to Li Qingcang.
He didn't speak anymore, he just stretched out a finger and tapped it lightly on a table next to him made of thousand-year-old cold iron.
There is no fluctuation of true energy, no leakage of spiritual power.
It's such an understatement.
A soft sound.
The cold iron desk, which was indestructible and could withstand a full blow from a Taoist palace expert, was actually centered on the position pointed by his finger.
It silently turned into a handful of black powder that was finer than dust and scattered to the ground.
Li Qingcang's body stiffened suddenly.
He stared intently at the handful of powder on the ground. His whole body felt as if he was struck by lightning, and huge waves arose in his mind!
This is not a crushing force!
This is...the annihilation of Tao!
It is the power of higher-level laws that completely erases the essence of Han Tie!
This kind of method, let alone the Four Extremes Realm, even the legendary Dragon Transformation Realm powerhouse, would never be able to do it!
This...this is...
"Tianpin Kung Fu!"
The four words were almost squeezed out from between Li Qingcang's teeth. His body was shaking slightly from extreme shock.
Only the legendary Tianpin Kung Fu that points directly to the Sendai Avenue has such incredible power!
Your Majesty... Your Majesty has actually cultivated a heavenly skill? !
No wonder after six days of seclusion, the breath has undergone earth-shaking changes!
But why does Your Majesty let yourself see this?
A terrifying and absurd thought emerged from Li Qingcang's heart uncontrollably.
Is it possible...
Zhao Daoting looked at his horrified look, and an unspeakable smile escaped from the corner of his mouth.
"What you think in your heart is my answer."
Li Qingcang's brain exploded completely.
His legs went weak.
With a "pop" sound, he knelt heavily on the ground, completely stunned.
"Your Majesty... Your Majesty! You must not do this!"
His voice was trembling, this was no longer a reward, this was a reminder!
"Tianpin Kung Fu is the foundation of the royal family, and it is an absolute secret that will not be passed down!"
"Published to foreign ministers, this is a serious crime that shakes the foundation of the country! I...I dare not accept it even to the death!"
Zhao Daoting just looked at him quietly, with that profound gaze that seemed to have penetrated all his thoughts.
"I know what you are worried about."
"But from the moment Qingluan's child married An'er, your Li family was no longer a mere foreign minister."
"I and you, are monarchs and ministers, and also... in-laws. "
These two words were like thunder from the sky, exploding in Li Qingcang's mind!
He raised his head suddenly and stared blankly at the emperor in front of him.
In an instant, everything connected!
My daughter’s words of “an extremely rich and stable future” still ring in my ears!
That’s it!
It turns out that this is His Majesty’s true purpose!
Marriage is not given for humiliation, let alone for beating!
But to break the barrier between the monarch and his ministers, and to make it justifiable to reward this heavenly skill!
It was to tie the Li family completely and unbreakably to the royal chariot!
Daughter...my daughter!
She actually understood the emperor's inner thoughts buried deep under the Nine Layers Palace the moment the imperial edict was issued!
Li Qingcang was shocked, ecstatic, and ashamed.
He calls himself a veteran on the battlefield, but in terms of style and vision, he is miles away from his daughter who never leaves home!
"My lord... thank you for your grace! "
Li Qingcang banged his head heavily on the ground without any hesitation.
You treat me as a nobleman of the country, and I will repay you as a nobleman of the country!
Zhao Daoting nodded with satisfaction. What he wanted was Li Qingcang's absolute loyalty.
He stretched out a finger and touched Li Qingcang's eyebrows.
“Concentrate and be calm. "
A vast and mysterious torrent of information instantly poured into Li Qingcang's mind.
"Dao Tian Yan Jing"!
Domineering! Mysterious! Miraculous!
Countless cultivation concepts and miraculous methods that he had never imagined exploded in his sea of consciousness.
It completely overturned his understanding of spiritual practice in the past hundreds of years.
It turns out that the wheel sea can be opened up like this!
It turns out that Tao Palace can evolve like this!
He was immersed in the mystery of this Tianpin technique, unable to extricate himself, and his whole person fell into a wonderful state of enlightenment.
After a long time, when he broke free from that state, Zhao Daoting had already sat back on the dragon throne.
Li Qingcang kowtowed again, this time with awe and surrender from the bottom of his heart.
"My minister, Li Qingcang, is willing to fight for your majesty, even if I die!" "
Zhao Daoting picked up the tea cup and took a sip, as if he had done an insignificant thing.
He put down the teacup and spoke casually.
"I passed this technique on to you for An'er. "
"Click! "
Li Qingcang's head that he just raised froze instantly.
His whole body seemed to have been cast a body-fixing spell, and his kneeling posture instantly solidified into a sculpture.
Wha...what?
It was... who gave it to me?
Sixteenth prince?
The one who couldn't open up the sea of suffering and was regarded as a waste by the entire imperial city... Zhao Chenan? !
Although Li Qingcang is naive, he is not stupid.
After hearing this, he already knew that he and the Li family would be completely tied to the Sixteenth Prince from now on!
The next day, early morning.
The sky suddenly dawned, and the entire imperial city was still shrouded in the hazy morning light.
In front of the Sixteenth Prince's residence, there was already a bustle of people and a bustling scene.
Hundreds of Forbidden Army soldiers with bright armor and holding halberds stood on both sides.
Forming two mighty and majestic long dragons, extending from the entrance of the house to the end of the long street.
Behind the imperial army, there were hundreds of musicians dressed in festive red clothes, holding various musical instruments and getting ready.
The long line of wedding receptions is endless as far as the eye can see.
The eight-carrying sedan chair has a golden roof and a red curtain, embroidered with auspicious patterns of dragons and phoenixes, and is extremely luxurious.
This battle, this scale, how can you marry a concubine?
Even when the queen entered the palace, it was nothing more than that!
The entire imperial city was alarmed!
Countless people and monks poured out of their homes and stood on both sides of the street.
He pointed at this extremely luxurious team with a look of disbelief on his face.
A tall and tall young man wearing a bright red wedding robe is sitting astride an extraordinary white dragon horse.
It was Zhao Chenan who was the protagonist of this grand wedding.
on his faceWith a hearty smile, he looked past the crowd and towards the direction of the Cavalry General's Mansion.
The master of ceremonies raised the flag in his hand high, took a deep breath, used all his strength, and let out a loud shout.
"The auspicious time has come!"
"Have fun! Let's go!"
